warhorn.warlord.name: Grimvald Ironhorn
warhorn.warlord.title: Warlord of the Illagers · Breaker of a Hundred Gates
warhorn.intro.line1: A horn sounds from the woods. Then another.
warhorn.intro.title: The Siege
warhorn.intro.subtitle: They have come to take the village
warhorn.intro.line2: Behind that banner marches an army.
warhorn.victory.title: The village stands
warhorn.victory.subtitle: The morning belongs to the living
warhorn.defeat.title: The village has fallen
warhorn.defeat.subtitle: Only ash remains, and memory
warhorn.hint.omen: The horn came from that way. Get ready.
warhorn.hint.first_act: Keep them away from the villagers.
warhorn.hint.interlude: A breather. Heal, gear up, barricade.
warhorn.hint.last_enemies: The last of them glow in the dark.
warhorn.hint.slam: He winds up. Jump when the ground shakes.
warhorn.hint.charge: Step aside. Wood won't stop him. Stone will.
warhorn.hint.arson: Torchbearers! Stop them before the houses burn.
warhorn.hint.rebuild: The village lies in ruins. Bring logs and cobblestone, hold them and click a damaged house – the villagers will rebuild it.
warhorn.command.started: Siege #%s begins. The host gathers at %s.
warhorn.command.kit: A chest with the recommended gear against Grimvald is ready.
warhorn.command.kits: %s chests with the recommended gear against Grimvald are ready.
warhorn.rebuild.milestone.1: A quarter of the village stands again
warhorn.hint.axe: The axe flies back to him. Stay out of its path; without it he is exposed.
warhorn.hint.leap: The red ring marks where he lands. Get out!
warhorn.hint.leap_recover: His axe is stuck in the ground. Strike now!
warhorn.hint.banner: The banner calls reinforcements. Break it!
warhorn.hint.last_stand: His armour is gone, but he hits harder than ever.
warhorn.hint.keg: A powder keg hisses against the wall – one blow on it and the fuse is out.
warhorn.unit.sapper.name: The Sapper
warhorn.unit.sapper.title: Powder and fuse
warhorn.unit.sapper.line1: He does not fight. He runs his keg to the nearest house wall.
warhorn.unit.sapper.line2: Cut him off – or knock the keg over before the fuse burns down.
warhorn.unit.ram.name: The Battering Ram
warhorn.unit.ram.title: Iron against timber
warhorn.unit.ram.line1: Four bearers drive it into the houses until the walls give way.
warhorn.unit.ram.line2: The log cannot be hurt – kill the bearers and it falls.
warhorn.hint.kidnap: A villager is in the sack! Catch the kidnapper before he reaches the trees.
warhorn.unit.kidnapper.name: The Kidnapper
warhorn.unit.kidnapper.title: A sack for everyone
warhorn.unit.kidnapper.line1: He shuns every fight. He wants your villagers – in his sack.
warhorn.unit.kidnapper.line2: With a full sack he is slow. Catch him before he reaches the trees!
warhorn.hint.catapult: Fire pots from the tree line! Follow the smoke trail back to the catapult.
warhorn.hint.catapult_smash: A few good blows and the frame falls apart.
warhorn.unit.catapult.name: The Catapult
warhorn.unit.catapult.title: Fire from the tree line
warhorn.unit.catapult.line1: It stays by the trees and hurls burning pots onto your roofs.
warhorn.unit.catapult.line2: Kill its crew or smash the frame – then it falls silent.
warhorn.showcase.start: Showcase: the four new enemies. Sit back – you will be brought back here afterwards.
warhorn.showcase.end: Showcase over – back where you were.
warhorn.showcase.title: Warhorn
warhorn.showcase.subtitle: Four new enemies
warhorn.showcase.end_subtitle: They come with the next horn.
warhorn.showcase.blocked: There is no room for the stage above you. Move somewhere else and try again.
warhorn.rebuild.how: Right-click the house with logs or cobblestone in hand
warhorn.rebuild.busy: This house is being rebuilt right now.
warhorn.rebuild.scene.title: Rebuilt
warhorn.rebuild.scene.subtitle: The whole village lent a hand
